maririna.en: maririna, a sound syllable of the Goddess's music

siddhi.hi: सिद्धि, योगसे प्राप्त अलौकिक शक्ति / सिद्धि, इस चालीसाके कवि
siddhi.en: a supernatural power gained by yoga / Siddhi, the poet of this Chālīsā

sundarī.en: Sundarī, Tripurasundarī, one of the ten Mahāvidyās

tacchu.en: tacchu, a sound syllable of the Goddess's music

tārā.en: Tārā, one of the ten Mahāvidyā goddesses

vidyāvatī.en: Vidyāvatī, 'mistress of knowledge', a name of the Goddess

सिद्धि.hi: योग और तपसे मिलनेवाली अलौकिक शक्ति (अणिमा आदि) / सिद्धि, इस चालीसाके कवि (‘सिद्धि कवि’)
सिद्धि.en: a supernatural power won by yoga and austerity (aṇimā and the others) / Siddhi, the poet of this Chālīsā (‘siddhi kavi’)
